question: The book 'A Brief History of Time' has been written by:
solution:
The correct answer is **__Stephen Hawking__**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Stephen Hawking:__

 __
 
• He was an English theoretical physicist, cosmologist, and author.
 
• He is the author of the best-selling book, "A Brief History of Time".
 
• Hawkings redefined cosmology by proposing that black holes emit radiation and later evaporate.
 
• Hawking was diagnosed with an early-onset slow-progressing form of motor neuron disease (amyotrophic lateral sclerosis "ALS" or Lou Gehrig's disease) that gradually paralyzed him over the decades.
 
• Stephen Hawking, the British Physicist, and the black hole theorist died on 14th March.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **J.V. Narlikar**: Jayant V. Narlikar is an Indian astrophysicist known for his work in cosmology. He has authored several books on science and astronomy,
 
• **Satyendranath Bose**: An Indian physicist known for his work on quantum mechanics, specifically Bose-Einstein statistics, in collaboration with Albert Einstein. He did not write *A Brief History of Time*.
 
• **C.V. Raman**: An Indian physicist renowned for discovering the Raman Effect, for which he won the Nobel Prize in Physics in 1930.
